g.text: The reference standard itself
Matched to the registry's own year
Matched to the current registry snapshot
Classified per provider-year, not a percentage
The same grid, drawn from the audit's own output. What Step 1 declared and this does not show is
exactly what the declaration rules removed.
Step 2. A comparison forms only where both sides carry a state
Three sources are matched to the registry's most recent snapshot because they have no per-record date. Doximity has one,
but every matched row falls in 2026, so it is a single snapshot too and the four together can support no claim about
change over time; NPPES = National Plan and Provider Enumeration System; DAC = Doctors and Clinicians, formerly Physician
Compare; PECOS = Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System; CCN = CMS Certification Number; NDH = National
Directory of Healthcare Providers; FHIR = Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources.
